title: From the WWW to the WWK
lead: Seven functions, many fields: from the address of a passage to the knowledge network.

steps.caption: The World Wide Web connected documents: every page was given an address, and every page could refer to every other.

lines: The World Wide Web connected documents: every page was given an address, and every page could refer to every other.

steps.caption: Language models answer fluently, but without grounds: their citations can be invented.

lines: Language models answer fluently, but without grounds: their citations can be invented.

steps.caption: Famulus carries this thought over to knowledge: what is connected is statements with their justifications.

card.title: From the WWW to the WWK
lines: What the WWW was for documents, the WWK is meant to become for knowledge
World-Wide Knowledge: a network of addressed, fallible holdings examined by the scientific community

steps.caption: Every document, page and segment has a permanent address.

lines: Every document, page and segment has a permanent address.

steps.caption: The address leads to the wording. A citation is composed only from recorded bibliographic data; where data is missing, the citation states the gap.

lines: The address leads to the wording. A citation is composed only from recorded bibliographic data; where data is missing, the citation states the gap.

steps.caption: For validation only the grounding evidence counts. Every kind of evidence has its address: sentence, figure, object, register entry and the single cell of a table.

lines: For validation only the grounding evidence counts. Every kind of evidence has its address: sentence, figure, object, register entry and the single cell of a table.

steps.caption: The same passage in the edition of Euler's correspondence: the facsimile on the left, the transcription on the right.
The rules of usage are registered, citable and revisable – relative to author, work and time.

lines: The rules of usage are registered, citable and revisable – relative to author, work and time.

steps.caption: A term leads to its entry: its senses in the usage of the collection, with the attested passages.
The Famulus experts form a system of supplementing skills: tables, calculations, models, sky and time. Each commands one instrument of reasoning.

lines: The Famulus experts form a system of supplementing skills: tables, calculations, models, sky and time. Each commands one instrument of reasoning.

steps.caption: Certified means measured: every computation is checked against documented comparisons.

lines: Certified means measured: every computation is checked against documented comparisons.

steps.caption: One catalogue lists for each expert its domain, status, measured comparisons and gaps.
The evidence: every statement split into its parts, and every part bound to the wording of the source.

evidence.aussage: Christian Goldbach wurde am 18. März 1690 in Königsberg in Ostpreußen geboren.

teile.spanne_voll: was born on March 18th, 1690, at Königsberg

evidence.beleg: Christian Goldbach was born on March 18th, 1690, at Königsberg in Eastern Prussia
evidence.ref: Opera omnia IV A 4, introduction, p. 4

steps.caption: What the evidence does not carry is marked as not validated. That is no verdict of falsity.

card.title: “Not validated” does not mean “false”
lines: A sentence is factually validated when its propositions follow from registered grounds
Missing evidence justifies nothing and refutes nothing

steps.caption: In the Famulus Notebook the researcher asks a question; an agent plays the score, and the block records answer, check and provenance together.

lines: In the Famulus Notebook the researcher asks a question; an agent plays the score, and the block records answer, check and provenance together.

steps.caption: Notebooks stay private, are shared in a group or are published.
A notebook becomes an issue of the series Famulus Expertise. The quality seal presupposes three necessary conditions and the author's release.

lines: A notebook becomes an issue of the series Famulus Expertise. The quality seal presupposes three necessary conditions and the author's release.

steps.caption: 5 issues are online, 0 of them with the quality seal. Every issue stays open to critique.
The network needs no centre: every reference point publishes its own signed register.

lines: The network needs no centre: every reference point publishes its own signed register.

steps.caption: What is connected is not documents but statements with their justifications. Reference points of other institutions are future work.

lines: What is connected is not documents but statements with their justifications. Reference points of other institutions are future work.

steps.caption: The Web grew because a reference cost one line. In the WWK the reference to a piece of evidence costs one line as well.

lines: The Web grew because a reference cost one line. In the WWK the reference to a piece of evidence costs one line as well.

steps.caption: Famulus Science: modules that accompany the working process of research. Each rests on the seven functions.

lines: Famulus Science: modules that accompany the working process of research. Each rests on the seven functions.

steps.caption: From the research question to the publication: Famulus for science and research.
A field of application is a combination of the functions. A new field brings its own holdings, its own rules of language and its own experts; everything else is there.

lines: A field of application is a combination of the functions. A new field brings its own holdings, its own rules of language and its own experts; everything else is there.

steps.caption: Built today: the address order, the register without a centre within the project's own network, the addresses of notebooks, the import of published issues.
